releases.name: Kisab 0.2.1

releases.name: Kisab 0.2.0
releases.summary: Farmer pilot candidate: 5-part navigation shell, Today dashboard, Khata ledger, six record flows, Farm Work, multi-farm management, offline calculator toolbox, versioned backup.

releases.name: Kisab v0.1.0
releases.summary: First published production release: a single offline farm, livestock/crop entries, transaction history, and versioned backup/restore.
releases.summaryNe: पहिलो प्रकाशित संस्करण: एउटा अफलाइन फार्म, पशुधन/बाली प्रविष्टिहरू, लेनदेन इतिहास, र संस्करणयुक्त ब्याकअप/पुनर्स्थापना।
